report.scope: Complete repeated numerical solves with ordinary output. The two fwp variants differ only in fwp_format_g. C/Rust use matched coordinate formulas but reuse two buffers; fwp uses immutable arrays. Timing includes process start, arithmetic, output and cleanup; excludes compilation, validation, profiles and RSS probes. All timed outputs are checked. Memory instrumentation can prevent optimizations; its counts are not traces of timed binaries. C/Rust profiles cover numerical buffers only; process RSS covers the whole process. A single-run screen is not acceptance: repeat on matching CPU models and report every case, including regressions.

report.scope: Complete repeated numerical solves with ordinary output. The two fwp variants differ only in fwp_format_g. C/Rust use matched coordinate formulas but reuse two buffers; fwp uses immutable arrays. Timing includes process start, arithmetic, output and cleanup; excludes compilation, validation, profiles and RSS probes. All timed outputs are checked. Memory instrumentation can prevent optimizations; its counts are not traces of timed binaries. C/Rust profiles cover numerical buffers only; process RSS covers the whole process. A single-run screen is not acceptance: repeat on matching CPU models and report every case, including regressions.

report.scope: Complete repeated numerical solves with ordinary output. The two fwp variants differ only in fwp_format_g. C/Rust use matched coordinate formulas but reuse two buffers; fwp uses immutable arrays. Timing includes process start, arithmetic, output and cleanup; excludes compilation, validation, profiles and RSS probes. All timed outputs are checked. Memory instrumentation can prevent optimizations; its counts are not traces of timed binaries. C/Rust profiles cover numerical buffers only; process RSS covers the whole process. A single-run screen is not acceptance: repeat on matching CPU models and report every case, including regressions.

measurements.scope: Independent inspection of 60 formatter measurement/profile files and 60 existing output/lifetime controls. Timing acceptance requires repeated matching hosts.

report.scope: Complete repeated numerical solves with ordinary output. The two fwp variants differ only in fwp_format_g. C/Rust use matched coordinate formulas but reuse two buffers; fwp uses immutable arrays. Timing includes process start, arithmetic, output and cleanup; excludes compilation, validation, profiles and RSS probes. All timed outputs are checked. Memory instrumentation can prevent optimizations; its counts are not traces of timed binaries. C/Rust profiles cover numerical buffers only; process RSS covers the whole process. A single-run screen is not acceptance: repeat on matching CPU models and report every case, including regressions.

measurements.scope: Independent inspection of 60 formatter measurement/profile files and 60 existing output/lifetime controls. Timing acceptance requires repeated matching hosts.
